# vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp

## Overview

[`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L839-L920) registers `indirect_dispatch`, covering indirect compute commands supplied by CPU buffer upload or generated by a compute shader. The test matrix varies command offsets, command reuse, workgroup sizes, empty commands, compute-only queues, and non-VulkanSC device-address-command variants.

## Role

Implementation file.

## Source Code

- Primary source: [`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L1)
- Factory declaration: [`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.hpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.hpp#L37-L38)

## Registration Hierarchy

```text
compute.pipeline.indirect_dispatch
├── upload_buffer
└── gen_in_compute
```

## Test Families

### upload_buffer — Uploaded indirect dispatch buffer

The `upload_buffer` group is created and populated in [`createIndirectComputeDispatchTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L874-L892). It receives each base dispatch case, a compute-only-queue variant, and a subset of non-VulkanSC `VK_KHR_device_address_commands` variants selected by pipeline-construction parity ([`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L899-L916)).

### gen_in_compute — Compute-generated indirect dispatch buffer

The `gen_in_compute` group registers the same base and compute-only cases, but its indirect command buffer contents are written by a compute shader before indirect dispatch ([`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L879-L897), [`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L790-L830)).

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Observed values |
|---|---|
| Dispatch case names | `single_invocation`, `multiple_groups`, `multiple_groups_multiple_invocations`, `small_offset`, `large_offset`, `large_offset_multiple_invocations`, `empty_command`, `multi_dispatch`, and `multi_dispatch_reuse_command` are declared in `s_dispatchCases` ([`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L842-L872)) |
| Workgroup size | Examples include `1x1x1`, `2x3x1`, and `3x1x2` in the same static array ([`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L844-L867)) |
| Indirect buffer offsets | Offset cases include `0`, `16`, `(1 << 20) + 12`, and repeated offsets such as `104` and `52` ([`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L852-L870)) |
| Queue and command source | Each base case is registered for normal and compute-only queue variants; device-address-command variants are added in non-VulkanSC builds ([`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L882-L916)) |

## Support / Feature Requirements

Compute-only variants require a queue family with `VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT` and without `VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT`; otherwise the test throws `NotSupportedError` ([`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L661-L680)). Device-address-command variants require `VK_KHR_device_address_commands` ([`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L683-L684)). Shader-object construction requirements are checked before execution ([`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L686-L686)).

## Verification Methods

For `gen_in_compute`, the file emits a compute shader that writes indirect-command triplets into a storage buffer at the configured offsets ([`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L790-L829)), dispatches that generator, and inserts a compute-to-indirect buffer barrier before indirect command consumption ([`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L751-L768)). This directly exercises whether generated or uploaded dispatch parameters affect subsequent compute invocations.

## Test Principles Observed

- The source directly targets the test-plan requirement that compute dispatch parameters and workgroup counts reach shader invocations ([`apitests.adoc`](../../../../../doc/testspecs/VK/apitests.adoc#L679)).
- The same case matrix is run through both uploaded and compute-generated indirect-command paths ([`vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/compute/vktComputeIndirectComputeDispatchTests.cpp#L889-L897)).

## Notes / Uncertainties

- Device-address-command cases are conditionally compiled out for VulkanSC; the tree lists only the always-created direct subgroups.
